counter_scope: Wall, driver, phases, RSS and work_changes use the mean of A/B report medians. Canonical metrics.search_work, published_models and candidates_examined use each report's first timed sample; work_medians decodes all timed samples.
method: For each cell, arithmetic mean of two per-report medians; percentage = candidate / baseline - 1. Wall and driver sums use common completed cells only. Peak RSS is measured in separate memory runs. No pooled-sample median or statistical significance claim.

suites.method: arithmetic mean of A/B per-report medians; sums only common completed cells; RSS from separate memory rounds
